The '''Mapuzo system''' was a [[star system]] located in the [[Hollan sector]] of the [[Mid Rim Territories]].<ref name="Appendix" /> The [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Inquisitorius]] was able to track Kenobi to Mapuzo. Three of their number—the [[Fifth Brother]], the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]], and the [[Fourth Sister]], accompanied by [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]—traveled to the planet in [[Hunt for Obi-Wan|search]] of Kenobi.<ref name="Kenobi III" />
